notes.title: Small update and title change
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26549088/b80c67ab712dde7e889dc1f5399c4e2b70864ec0.jpg[/img]


After extended holiday vacation we are back to work.

We were carefully listening to all your comments and we plan to polish the game to remove all those things that you dislike.

First things we were able to quickly change are included in this update:

[list]
[*]There is a small info how you can manipulate difficulty level (you can do that but choosing different number of players and different AI types). We will be working to making it even clearer

[*]As for some of you it was unclear when you are harvesting minerals and how many we decided to introduce a pop-up window with this information. We hope that would help

[*] We were also receiving some complaints that it is not clear if the game is a board game. As no one yet tagged this game as a board game, we decided to add such an info in the title.

[/list]

We plan to bring you more updates soon. Please feel welcome to let us know what would you like to see improved.

We wish you happy playing 

Developers of Galaxy of Trian Digital Edition
